correctness.rationale: The graph is the Cartesian C4 x C7, with 28 vertices and 56 edges. Independent column-state enumeration independently obtained 96,433 faces including empty, with cardinality counts (1,28,322,1988,7266,16464,23786,22540,14602,6748,2198,448,42) and reduced Euler characteristic -1. I independently reconstructed the exact 28-vertex priority-toggle matching: 48,214 disjoint pairs on 96,432 nonempty faces, critical cells one 0-cell, two 5-cells, one 6-cell; all 623,448 nonempty Hasse covers topologically sort (623,476 including the 28 empty-to-vertex covers). Signed gradient projection of the critical 6-cell boundary to both critical 5-cells yields the integer vector (0,0), not merely mod-p zero. Forman produces a CW model whose five-skeleton is S5 wedge S5. pi5 of that simply connected wedge equals integral H5 by Hurewicz, so zero-degree attaching map is null, giving S5 wedge S5 wedge S6. Exhaustiveness is finite only for this exact 4-by-7 torus.
